meta_description:
jeffreestar on September 6, 2026: "Bactrian camel party!! 🐫🐫🐫 We just had Dr. Morrow AKA @hooveshumpsandhorns out here at the ranch for a week training and working on our herd! It was such a pleasure spending so much time with him, he has the best energy and has so much patience! Truly a blessing for the camel world to have him. 

As the summer is coming to an end, we are excited to start our new breeding program with ￼our white bull Tundra and create some magic out here! 🙏🏻 #jeffreestar #camel #wyoming".
